name: singlet_markers_de_cluster_marker_ranking
title: Rank cluster marker genes
description: Ranks genes that separate each cluster or cell type from the other cells, or from one chosen contrast group, and writes per-group marker tables with a score, log fold change and detection fractions. Needs a log-normalised layer and one categorical label per cell. The default method is wilcoxon. Do not read its p-values as calibrated error rates, and do not use it for condition effects between donors; use singlet_markers_de_replicate_aware_condition_de for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

groupby.description: Categorical obs column holding the cluster or cell-type label to rank within.

contrast.description: 'rest' compares each group with all other cells; a group label gives a one-vs-one comparison.

method.description: Ranking score. wilcoxon is the default; logreg gives a coefficient score without p-values.

layer.description: Log-normalised layer to test; t_test, cohen_d and auroc need log values.

n_genes.description: Top genes kept per group, ordered by descending score.

min_pct.description: Minimum detection fraction on either side, for wilcoxon, t_test and cohen_d candidates.

min_logfc.description: Minimum absolute log fold change for wilcoxon, t_test and cohen_d candidates; pre-filter only.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

wilcoxon.description: Options for the wilcoxon method only.

tie_correct.description: Use the tie-corrected variance; needed for discrete counts with many ties.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, contrast, n_groups, n_genes_tested, top_markers (first five genes per group).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
